# Operations: Shapes (programs, sketches, configurations, sheets)

Run with `./ise commit <operation> '<json parameters>'`, the MCP tool `ise_commit`, or `./ise run steps.json` for several at once (one undo step). 40 operations.

### `canvas.create`

a reference picture on a plane of the model.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anchor` | number[] |  | The pixel to put at the plane's origin (default the picture's middle). |
| `aspect` | number |  |  |
| `at` | number[] |  | Where the anchor pixel lands in the world (mm); moves the plane there. |
| `background` | number[] |  |  |
| `calibrate` | Calibration |  | Two pixels and the true distance between them (sets the scale). |
| `crop` | number[] |  | [left, top, right, bottom] pixels. |
| `flip` | boolean |  |  |
| `height` | number |  | The whole picture's height in mm (sets the scale). |
| `image` | string | yes | The picture (a stored picture's id): replacing it keeps the placement. |
| `level` | number[][] |  | Two pixels that should lie level: turns the picture so they do. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `object` | ObjectSize |  | The object's overall size: sets the scale (and aspect), and puts the outline's aligned corner at the origin. |
| `offset` | number |  | Moves a named plane this far along its normal (mm). |
| `opacity` | number |  |  |
| `perspective` | Perspective |  |  |
| `pivot` | Pivot |  | Turns the plane about a world axis through its origin: for a photo taken square on while the object stood pitched or rolled (resting on a grip, a foot), so comparisons look from where the camera really was. |
| `plane` | CanvasPlane |  |  |
| `reset` | string[] |  | Settings to clear: "crop", "perspective", "calibration", "rotation", "background", "threshold", "flip", "aspect". |
| `rotation` | number |  |  |
| `scale` | number |  | Millimetres per pixel. |
| `threshold` | number |  |  |
| `through` | boolean |  |  |
| `visible` | boolean |  |  |
| `width` | number |  | The whole picture's width in mm (sets the scale). |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **Calibration** (Two pixels a known distance apart.): `a`: number[], `b`: number[], `distance`: number
- **CanvasPlane**: string \| Plane \| object. Where a canvas lies: a named view's plane, a full frame, or a face (its centre and outward normal).
- **ObjectSize** (The object's overall size in the picture: its outline's bounds become `width` × `height` mm (either or both; both stretch a foreshortened photo), with the corner or middle `align` names at the plane's origin.): `align`?: string, `height`?: number, `width`?: number
- **Perspective** (Four pixels at the corners of a rectangle in the photo (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left as the picture shows them) and the rectangle's true size: the photo is squared up so it is `width` × `height` mm, centred on the plane's origin.): `height`: number, `points`: number[][], `width`: number
- **Pivot** (A turn about a world axis (right-handed, degrees).): `axis`: number[], `degrees`: number
- **Plane** (Where a sketch lies: an origin and two in-plane axes (mm, unit vectors).): `origin`: number[], `x`: number[], `y`: number[]

</details>

### `parameters.import`

fills a parameter set from a CSV or XLSX table (a new
set named `name` unless `target` names one). With a header row, columns
are found by name (key or name, label, value, unit, min, max, step,
formula); without, they are key, value, unit. Values may carry units
(`200 mm`, `2 in`, `45°`); keys that are not plain names are made into
one and the original kept as the label. Existing parameters take the new
values (a linked one keeps its formula); new ones are added.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base64` | string |  |  |
| `format` | string | yes | "csv" or "xlsx". |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `sheet` | string |  |  |
| `target` | StableId |  |  |
| `text` | string |  |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `shape.set_drawing`

Keeps a drawing's setup with the shape (an empty setup removes it).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `drawing` | DrawingSpec | yes | How a part's drawing is set up: a section, dimensions (with tolerances), detail views and geometrical tolerances the person added (one setup per part, or for the whole shape). |
| `target` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **AngleSpec** (An angle between the lines from `vertex` through `a` and through `b` (model mm along a view's axes).): `a`: number[], `b`: number[], `radius`?: number, `vertex`: number[], `view`: ViewName
- **ArcSpec** (An arc of a view: its centre, radius and the angles it runs between (°, anticlockwise from the view's right). Dimensioned by its radius, or by its length (⌒) when `length`.): `centre`: number[], `from`?: number, `length`?: boolean, `radius`: number, `to`?: number, `view`: ViewName
- **AreaSpec** (The area of the flat face under a point of a view.): `at`: number[], `view`: ViewName
- **AutoSpec** (How the drawing's own dimensions are kept: every feature is dimensioned once unless `off`; keys (as the drawing JSON's `autos` lists them, like "x:25", "d:20", "hole:5", "r:8", "c:1") pick single ones out.): `hide`?: string[], `off`?: boolean, `tolerances`?: AutoTolerance[]
- **AutoTolerance**: `key`: string, `tolerance`: Tolerance
- **AuxSpec** (An auxiliary view looking along `dir` (model), with `up` up the page.): `dir`: number[], `scale`?: number, `up`?: number[]
- **Axis**: `"x"`, `"y"`, `"z"`
- **BreakSpec** (A stretch of the part along an axis left out of the views (model mm from `from` to `to`).): `axis`: Axis, `from`: number, `to`: number
- **DatumSpec** (A datum feature symbol (ISO 5459) on a point of a view.): `at`: number[], `letter`: string, `place`?: number[], `view`: ViewName
- **DetailSpec** (A detail view: the circle of radius `radius` about `center` (model mm along the view's axes) drawn again larger, labelled DETAIL B (5:1).): `center`: number[], `place`?: number[], `radius`: number, `scale`?: number, `view`: ViewName
- **DimKind**: `"horizontal"` (Across the view.), `"vertical"` (Up the view.), `"aligned"` (Straight from one point to the other.)
- **DimSpec** (A dimension between two points of a view, kept in model millimetres so it stays on the part when the sheet or scale changes.): `a`: number[], `b`: number[], `detail`?: integer, `diameter`?: boolean, `kind`?: DimKind, `offset`?: number, `tolerance`?: Tolerance, `view`: ViewName
- **DrawingSpec** (How a part's drawing is set up: a section, dimensions (with tolerances), detail views and geometrical tolerances the person added (one setup per part, or for the whole shape).): `angles`?: AngleSpec[], `arcs`?: ArcSpec[], `areas`?: AreaSpec[], `auto`?: AutoSpec, `aux`?: AuxSpec[], `breaks`?: BreakSpec[], `datums`?: DatumSpec[], `details`?: DetailSpec[], `dimensions`?: DimSpec[], `explode`?: Explode, `finishes`?: FinishSpec[], `frames`?: FrameSpec[], `half_section`?: boolean, `hatch`?: Hatch, `hole_fits`?: HoleFit[], `leaders`?: LeaderSpec[], `lines`?: LineSpec[], `notes`?: string[], `part`?: string, `revisions`?: Revision[], `roughness`?: Roughness, `section`?: number, `section_at`?: number, `section_view`?: ViewName, `sheets`?: SheetSpec[], `tables`?: TableSpec[], `texts`?: TextSpec[], `threads`?: ThreadSpec[], `title_block`?: TitleFields, `welds`?: WeldSpec[]
- **Explode** (An exploded isometric: each part slid along `axis` (x, y or z) clear of those it stacks on, `gap` sheet-independent mm apart (8 % of the assembly's size along the axis when absent).): `axis`?: ExplodeAxis, `gap`?: number
- **ExplodeAxis**: `"x"`, `"y"`, `"z"`

- **FrameSpec** (A feature control frame pointing at a point of a view (model mm along its axes).): `at`: number[], `datums`?: string[], `diameter_zone`?: boolean, `modifier`?: Modifier, `place`?: number[], `symbol`: GdtSymbol, `tolerance`: number, `view`: ViewName
- **GdtSymbol**: `"straightness"`, `"flatness"`, `"circularity"`, `"cylindricity"`, `"line_profile"`, `"surface_profile"`, `"parallelism"`, `"perpendicularity"`, `"angularity"`, `"position"`, `"concentricity"`, `"symmetry"`, `"circular_runout"`, `"total_runout"`. Geometrical characteristics (ISO 1101).
- **Hatch** (Section hatching: lines at `angle`° (from the horizontal), `spacing` mm apart, crossed when `cross`.): `angle`?: number, `cross`?: boolean, `spacing`?: number
- **HoleFit** (A fit on holes of one diameter: their callout reads ⌀16 H7 with its deviations.): `diameter`: number, `fit`: string
- **LeaderSpec** (A note on a leader pointing at a point of a view (model mm along its axes).): `at`: number[], `text`: string, `view`: ViewName
- **LineSpec** (A line drawn on a view between two points (model mm along its axes), or through more.): `points`: number[][], `style`?: LineStyle, `view`: ViewName

### `shape.set_study`

Keeps a part's study with the shape (no supports and no loads removes it).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `study` | StudySpec | yes | A study as kept with the shape. |
| `target` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **BearingPick** (A force on a round face, as a bearing (or a shaft in a bore) gives it.): `face`: FacePick, `force`: number[]
- **Bolt** (A bolt pretensioned: the bolt part is shortened across its section at `at` until it pulls with `preload`, then held at that length while the loads come on.): `at`: number[], `axis`: number[], `part`?: string, `preload`: number
- **ContactKind**: `"frictionless"` (They push on each other but never pull, and slide freely.), `"friction"` (They push, never pull, and grip up to `friction` × the push before sliding.), `"bonded"` (Glued: they move together where they touch.)
- **ContactSpec** (The contact between two parts studied together (pairs not listed are frictionless).): `friction`?: number, `kind`?: ContactKind, `parts`: string[], `press_fit`?: boolean
- **Convection** (Air carrying heat away from every outside face.): `ambient`: number, `h`: number
- **DisplacementPick** (A face moved by set amounts (mm) along some axes; null leaves one free.): `by`: number[], `face`: FacePick
- **ElasticPick** (A face on springs: N/mm per mm² of face.): `face`: FacePick, `normal_only`?: boolean, `stiffness`: number
- **FacePick** (A face as kept with a study: where on the part it sits (fractions of the part's bounds: its middle, and a point on one of its triangles) and which way it faces, so it is found again after the part changes.): `at`?: number[], `curved`?: boolean, `near`?: number[], `normal`: number[], `part`?: string, `probe`?: number[]
- **FatigueSpec** (How the loads come and go, and how the part is made, for a fatigue estimate.): `cycles`?: number, `diameter`?: number, `ratio`?: number, `reliability`?: number, `surface`?: string
- **HeatPick**: `face`: FacePick, `watts`: number
- **HeatStress** (Heat as a load in the stress study.): `reference`: number
- **HoldPick**: `face`: FacePick, `temperature`: number
- **LoadPick**: `direction`: string, `face`: FacePick, `magnitude`: number
- **RemotePick** (A force and moment at a point (part coordinates, mm) carried to a face.): `face`: FacePick, `force`?: number[], `moment`?: number[], `point`: number[]
- **Spin** (Spinning about an axis.): `at`: number[], `axis`: number[], `rpm`: number
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.
- **StudySpec** (A study as kept with the shape.): `bearing_loads`?: BearingPick[], `bolts`?: Bolt[], `contacts`?: ContactSpec[], `convection`?: Convection, `displacements`?: DisplacementPick[], `elastic_supports`?: ElasticPick[], `fatigue`?: FatigueSpec, `gravity`?: number[], `heat_stress`?: HeatStress, `heats`?: HeatPick[], `holds`?: HoldPick[], `loads`?: LoadPick[], `part`?: string, `parts`?: string[], `plastic`?: boolean, `prestress`?: boolean, `refine`?: boolean, `remote_loads`?: RemotePick[], `resolution`?: integer, `sliding`?: FacePick[], `spin`?: Spin, `supports`?: FacePick[], `transient`?: Transient
- **Transient** (How a transient heat study runs.): `duration`: number, `initial`: number, `steps`?: integer

</details>
